The staff are always polite, listen to your concerns and do not hesitate to refer you elsewhere if needed. If you need a MRI they will tell you and refer you straight away, while my previous GP would say we don't have the ability to refer and only A&E does, then you go to A&E and they would report my previous GP for a inappropriate referral. I got the correct diagnoses I need from this GP, as they always go above and beyond. I suddenly lost my hearing in my left ear and the Doctor referred me to A&E in Oxford where I then saw the ENT who are now working with me to help get my hearing back and have prescribed me steroids. They also actually send medication to the correct pharmacy, I know this is the standard but my previous GP would some how send it to Kent everytime even after complaining on countless occasions that we don't live nor have ever lived in Kent.
The building is also nice and cozy.
